card.line: Tiberias was a city on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, built by Herod Antipas, and boats from there appear in John's story of the crowd seeking Jesus.

moments.title: Boats from Tiberias arrive
moments.text: After Jesus gave thanks and fed the people with bread, some boats from Tiberias landed near that place. The crowd used boats like these to cross to Capernaum and look for Jesus.
